The '''Rapid Deployment station''' was a pre-fabricated and modular structure that was produced by [[Nen-Carvon]]. It was smaller than the [[IM-455 modular garrison|standard Imperial garrison]] and could be deployed from smaller [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. They were often built off-site and delivered via a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] or [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]]. The stations were typically used for short term military operations, police actions, or training. They could be deployed to harsh environments, like [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuums]]. If more space was required, multiple stations could be linked together to form a larger facility.<ref name="H&S" />

==Layout==
The Rapid Deployment station consisted of an octagonal base and up to four modular compartments. These would differ depending on the mission. The base was surrounded by a thick metal mesh that was electrified to prevent animals or other creatures from getting under the station. While not intended for heavy combat, they could be armed with weapon emplacements.<ref name="H&S" />

==Modular units==
There were nine different types of modular units that could be installed in a Rapid Deployment station. Four were for support and five were for habitation. These included electronics, laboratories, medical, detention, living quarters, command centers, and conference rooms.<ref name="H&S" />
